resources.string: Troubleshooting

On BOTH devices:
- Bluetooth is on
- Wi-Fi is on (it does not need to be connected to a network)
- Location is on (Android 12 or older only)
- Google Play services is installed and up to date
- Monogatari is open in the foreground

Then tap Receive on one device first, wait until it says it is visible, and tap Send on the other device.
Check this device
Device check
Everything this device needs for Nearby sync looks fine.
Fix the items marked PROBLEM, then try again.

OK: %1$s

Google Play services is missing, disabled or out of date on this device. Nearby sync needs it.
Airplane mode is on and Bluetooth or Wi-Fi is off. Turn off Airplane mode, or turn Bluetooth and Wi-Fi back on.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on (on both devices).
Wi-Fi is off. Turn it on (on both devices). It does not need to be connected to a network.
Location services are off. Android 12 or older needs Location turned on for Nearby.
These permissions are still needed: %1$s.
Google Play services is available

Bluetooth is on
Wi-Fi is on

Open Wi-Fi settings
Open Location settings

Nearby permissions were denied: %1$s. Discovery is unavailable until they are allowed.

Transfer canceled by the other device or by a disconnect. [canceled]

The connection was lost during the transfer. Nothing was changed. Start again: Receive on one device, then Send on the other.
Step 1 of 4: visible to nearby Monogatari devices. Now tap Send on the other device.
Step 1 of 4: searching nearby. Make sure the other device has tapped Receive.
Step 2 of 4: found %1$s. Tap it to connect.
Step 3 of 4: compare the pairing code on both screens.
Step 4 of 4: paired securely. Either device may send a library or file.
Bluetooth or Wi-Fi is not available to Nearby. Turn both on and try again.
This device is already visible. Tap Stop and disconnect, then try again.
This device is already searching. Tap Stop and disconnect, then try again.
Already connected to that device. Tap Stop and disconnect to start over.
The connection was rejected. One device declined the pairing code, or the other device is not ready. Try again.
Not connected to the other device. Pair again.
Bluetooth or the radio reported an error. Turn Bluetooth off and on, then try again.
Another Nearby session is still active. Tap Stop and disconnect, then try again.
Steps happened in the wrong order. Tap Stop and disconnect, then tap Receive on one device first and Send on the other.
The other device is no longer available. Search again.
Lost contact with the other device. Move the devices closer together and try again.
The transfer data could not be read or written. Check free storage and try again.
Nearby reported a general error. Check Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and Location on both devices.
Location services must be on. Turn Location on and try again.
A required permission is missing. Open the app permission settings and allow all Nearby permissions.
Nearby is busy with another request. Tap Stop and disconnect, then try again.
Google Play services is missing, disabled or needs an update.
Google Play services could not start Nearby. Update Google Play services and try again.
Nearby timed out. Try again with both devices close together.
Nearby reported an unexpected problem.
